title: Survival outcomes and prognostic factors in <i>de novo</i> advanced biliary tract cancer: insights from a Saudi multicenter cohort.
caption: Kaplan–Meier curves of OS by number of therapy lines.
context: Kaplan–Meier curves of OS by number of therapy lines. In exploratory descriptive analyses, OS increased stepwise according to the number of therapy lines (P < 0.001; Figure 5 ): best supportive care (5.9 months), one line (7.3 months), two lines (13.5 months), three lines (17.1 months), and four lines (22.3 months).
